input.description:
Input for multi-view image-to-3D generation.

At least one view is required; provide as many of the four canonical
views as available for the best reconstruction.

enable_pbr.description: Generate PBR material maps together with the texture. Only supported (and billed) for v2.0/v2.1 and v3.0 models when enable_texture is true; ignored otherwise.

resolution.description: Generation resolution. Supported values depend on the model: v1.5/v2.0 accept 512, 1024, 1536 and 1536pro; v2.1 accepts 1536fast and 1536pro; scene-portraitv1.5 accepts 1536; scene-portraitv2.0 accepts 1536pro; scene-portraitv2.1 accepts 1536profast and 1536pro. Defaults to the model's recommended r

enable_texture.description: Whether to generate textures in addition to geometry. When false, only the geometry mesh is generated (and billed).

right_image_url.description: URL of the right view image (PNG/JPEG/WebP, up to 20MB).

face_count.description: Target face count of the generated model. When unset, the partner picks the recommended count for the resolution (e.g. 500k for 512, 1M for 1024, 2M for 1536).

front_image_url.description: URL of the front view image (PNG/JPEG/WebP, up to 20MB).

left_image_url.description: URL of the left view image (PNG/JPEG/WebP, up to 20MB).

export_format.description: File format of the generated model.

back_image_url.description: URL of the back view image (PNG/JPEG/WebP, up to 20MB).

model.description: Model version used for generation. 'hitem3d*' are the general models; 'scene-portrait*' are tuned for portraits/characters.

enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, input images are checked for safety before processing.
